messages:
maria: opened PR with new offline preflight scripts for private installs (bash + ps1). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4870

alex: skimmed. looks good. please add explicit file-perm examples (chmod 600 and Set-Acl) and a short warning about leaving private keys world-readable.

sam: for PS, recommend `Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256` but include a PS5 fallback using .NET APIs. also add example output for both success and failure paths so support can triage quickly.

maria: will add PS5 fallback and sample outputs. adding a `--dry-run` flag so docs-ci can run without touching real KMS endpoints.

tina: agree on `--dry-run`. also include local server test instructions (openssl s_server + python testserver) so offline sites can validate TLS locally. add a note that openssl s_client is optional and may not exist on Windows.

infra-bot: docs-ci: PR 4870 lint and linkcheck passed; sample-run executed in dry-run mode. artifacts: https://ci.redwood.dev/artifacts/4870 :white_check_mark:

maria: added `--no-network` env option and a short systemd unit example for a cert-cache helper. dropped an appendix for local testserver commands.

jeff: nit: rename `$bundlePath` -> `$certBundlePath` in PS for clarity. also include the expected exit codes for the scripts.

sam: suggest adding an optional pkcs11 one-liner for HSM users: `pkcs11-tool --list-objects -l -k` with a note about provider path and PIN prompt. label as optional and platform-specific.

maria: added pkcs11 snippet and explicit warning not to commit PINs or lib paths.

tina: add simple connectivity checks for common blockers: `curl --connect-timeout`, `nc -vz`, and `dig`/`nslookup` examples and include common false positives like captive portals and MTU issues.

maria: included tracer checks and a "Troubleshooting" mini-section listing expired cert, SAN mismatch, incorrect CA, network MTU/NAT issues, and captive proxies with sample outputs.

security: reviewed and acked. requested adding pointer to Key Handling policy and a reminder to rotate ephemeral CI certs and avoid logging raw DER blobs.

alex: LGTM after security ack.

infra-bot: docs-ci: all checks green.

maria: merged after approvals. will follow up with a small PR to add a Windows Authenticode signing note and link to the installer FAQ. saved snippets to internal snippet repo for support. closing thread. :tada:
